evals.prompt: 本機 Metabase 在 http://localhost:3000，mb profile 是 metabase-ai，裡面有 Sample Database。幫我做一個「產品類別分析」儀表板：上面放各類別的營收長條圖，下面放每月訂單數折線圖，點長條圖要能把下面的折線圖篩成那個類別。做在 ~/work/sales-dash 這個資料夾。
evals.expected_output: Writes card and dashboard definitions as files under a metabase/ content root (mbac init), uses placeholders instead of numeric ids, pushes with mbac push, records ids in ids/metabase-ai.json, and does not call mb card create / mb dashboard create directly. Verifies by running the cards and returns dashboard URLs.

evals.prompt: 同事說他在 Metabase UI 上把「每月營收」那張卡的標題改了，還調了顏色。我現在要把那張卡的 SQL 改成只算已付款訂單，改完幫我推上去。repo 在 ~/work/sales-dash。
evals.expected_output: Runs mbac status or push, sees the item changed in Metabase since the last push, runs mbac diff, brings the UI title/colour changes into the definition (or asks), edits the SQL, then pushes with --force only after merging. Does not silently overwrite the UI edit.

evals.prompt: 在 ~/work/sales-dash 加一個新的 Model「每日訂單」（Sample Database 的 ORDERS 依日期彙總），欄位都要有中文說明。mbac.json 裡的 prod profile 是正式環境，做好之後也要上正式環境。
evals.expected_output: Writes models/<name>.sql + .json with columns metadata, pushes to the non-protected profile first and verifies, then asks the user before running push --create on the protected prod profile instead of passing --create on its own.
